definitions.full: H4655. miphlat מִפְלָט noun [masculine] escape (Hup Bae) or place of escape (We Du); — Psa 55:9 si vera 1.; ᵐ5 Che מְפַלֵּט deliverer . מְּלָיָה מְּלִי, see פלא . פלך (√ of following; compare Arabic II. be round (especially hemispherical ), whirl of spindle, so Assyrian pilakku ; Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; לֶךְ מֶּ ᵑ7 circuit, district ; Assyrian also pilku, district ).
